subject: Desktop task-scoped JSON persistence and session binding for the existing host-controlled ecommerce superpower dashboard
inside: Profile-owned task dashboard and hashed session-binding sidecar files
Strict scope identifiers, payload limits and known widget validation
Atomic serialized writes, revision CAS and operationId idempotency
Host commands for ensure binding, ensure/load document and controlled dashboard actions
Frontend Desktop bridge with explicit browser-local fallback
Persistent complete-research document and non-persistent demo projections
Existing trusted Widget Registry, conversation-inline and research-canvas rendering

outside.contract: Normalized platform-scoped facts and coverage enter as deterministic DashboardDocument seed JSON.
The caller may submit only one schema-valid declared dashboard action; executable UI source and paths are rejected by construction.
A profile-owned binding sidecar associates the active session identity with a capability task without mutating session records.
The prototype guarantees in-process serialization and atomic local replacement only.
When Wails bindings are unavailable, the same document contract uses the existing namespaced localStorage adapter.
